description: Read an owned model animation batch, asset-pack animation batch, or individual animation clip by target_type and target_id. Returns normalized status, counts, model/asset-pack references, clip IDs, action IDs, safe labels, chatUrl, and artifact availability flags. Raw animation GLB/FBX URLs, provider IDs, Trigger IDs, and storage internals are intentionally omitted.
name: get_model_animation
title: Get Model Animation
